'''Brco''' was an [[Ilwizzt]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[G'rho]] and served in the [[G'rho Defense Force]].

==Biography==
Brco achieved the rank of [[Major/Legends|major]] with the G'rho Defense Force, and was stationed at [[Boku Settlement]]. There he hired [[Ydra Kilwallen Sibwarra|Ydra Sibwarra]] as a historian, at the bidding of her brother [[Trig Kilwallen|Trig]], a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the Defense Force. When the [[Ssi-ruu]] invaded the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], Brco was in charge. He ordered the small G'rho Defense Force air force to attack the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Starship/Legends|ships]], but they were easily defeated. The Ssi-ruu retaliated by attacking Brco's compound with some form of knockout gas. Brco ordered an evacuation of the facility.
